name: T-Bar Row
summary: A heavy row using a barbell anchored at one end or a T-bar machine, with a close neutral grip that loads the mid back and lats.
setup: Anchor one end of the barbell in a corner or landmine and load the other end.
Straddle the bar, hinge at the hips with a flat back and grip the handle or the bar under the plates.
Stand the weight up, brace and keep the knees slightly bent.
execution: Pull the weight toward the lower chest, driving the elbows back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower under control until the arms are straight.
Hold the same torso angle on every rep.
mistakes: Jerking with the hips: lighten the load and keep the torso angle fixed.
Rounding the lower back: hinge from the hips and brace.
Cutting reps short: lower until the arms are fully straight.
Shrugging toward the ears: keep the shoulders down and pull with the elbows.
